summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal and delegating to Control.title. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the two-item form. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run: per instructions, no tests, mypy, or Black were executed, so verification is by reading only. Nothing was committed.
